newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco dismantle clandestine immigration ring.
newsitem.headline: Morocco dismantle clandestine immigration ring.

text.p: Moroccan security forces have arrested 12 Moroccans who ran an illegal immigration ring to bring people to Europe from Casablanca, a police spokesman said on Sunday.
"The would-be immigrant was obliged to pay in cash and in advance up to 30,000 dirhams ($3,448) before his arrival to Italy or France," the spokesman said.
The illegal immigrants, Moroccans and black Africans, usually travelled through Tunisia, Bulgaria and Greece before their final destination.
A Moroccan fisherman whose boat sank carrying 26 illegal immigrants to Spain was sentenced last week in Tangier to four years in jail. ($=8.7 dirhams)
